Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Senior Workday Grants Configuration Analyst is responsible for configuring, optimizing, and maintaining the Workday Grants Management module to support efficient post-award administration at Howard University. Reporting directly to the Associate Vice President for Post Award, this position collaborates with the Office of Research, Finance, and IT to improve workflows, address system-related issues, and ensure the accurate reflection of sponsored program activities in Workday. The analyst plays a critical role in triaging user issues, modifying business processes, and leading system cleanup and data integrity efforts.
Supervisory Authority
None
Nature And Scope
The analyst works across functional areas, including Post Award Services, Grants and Contracts Accounting, Sponsored Programs, IT, and external consultants, to optimize and sustain a compliant and responsive Workday environment for sponsored programs. The role supports business process owners and end-users in resolving configuration issues and implementing system improvements.
Principal Accountabilities
  • Analyze research expenditures and labor distributions in Workday to support federal reporting and internal decision-making.
  • Configure and maintain Workday Grants Management modules to ensure alignment with institutional post-award business practices.
  • Triage and resolve system issues impacting grant award setup, invoicing, financial reporting, and effort certification.
  • Partner with functional teams to map and test updated business processes and grant workflows.
  • Collaborate on crosswalks and data clean-up activities related to legacy awards, grant hierarchies, and worktags.
  • Develop and run data queries and reports to identify anomalies, monitor usage, and ensure data integrity.
  • Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate technical updates with IT and vendors as needed.
  • Assist with training and knowledge transfer to post-award staff related to new functionality or changes in Workday.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to enhance automation, accuracy, and compliance in post-award Workday functions.
  • Document Workday configuration decisions, enhancements, issue resolutions, and business process enhancements.
  • Support audits and compliance reviews requiring system-generated grant data.
Core Competencies
  • Strong knowledge of federal Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) as it relates to invoicing and financial reporting.
  • In-depth knowledge of Workday Grants or similar ERP grant modules (e.g., Oracle, Banner, PeopleSoft).
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise systems for sponsored research.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a complex data and system environment.
  • Knowledge of post-award processes including invoicing, award setup, and financial reporting.
  • Ability to interpret Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200) and sponsor compliance requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across technical and functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Excel, data analysis tools, and report generation platforms (Workday PRISM or equivalent).
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree required in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in ERP system administration or grants management system configuration.
  • Experience supporting grants or financial modules in Workday.
  • Familiarity with federal grant compliance frameworks and Uniform Guidance required.
  • Strong technical documentation and workflow mapping skills desirable.

Job description

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA COMERCIAL JÚNIOR – FOCO EM HUNTER E PRÉ-VENDA NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso que requer uma equipe com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões atuais na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.



Main responsibilities

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA COMERCIAL JÚNIOR são:

  • Analisar a carteira vigente e identificar as empresas que já possuem contato e relacionamento com o time ou não;
  • Mapear as empresas na carteira sem contato e entender se investem em treinamento e possuem área de T&D estruturada;
  • Identificar os responsáveis por T&D dessas empresas na carteira sem ponto focal;
  • Prospectar novas empresas (pública e privada) qualificadas que investem em treinamento e que não estão em nosso radar;
  • Agendar reuniões de apresentação institucional para que nossos executivos de contas possam conduzir e identificar possíveis demandas de capacitação;
  • Mapear a concorrência e identificar para quem elas oferecem serviço educacional (treinamentos e capacitação in company).


Requirements and skills

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência prévia na área comercial com prospecção e pré-venda;
  • Conhecimento com Salesforce - diferencial;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em pacote Office.


Additional information

Local de trabalho: IBMEC - Centro/RJ.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido.

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pais, mães e irmãos), permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale alimentação ou vale refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;
  • Wellhub ou Totalpass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Wellz uma plataforma voltada para a saúde mental e emocional dos colaboradores, oferecendo diversos tipos de acompanhamento, incluindo acesso a terapias online individuais;
  • Programa de bem-estar e clube de vantagens com vantagens exclusivas;
  • Dress code flexível para promover nossa diversidade;
  • Seguro de vida ;
  • Convênio com o SESC ;
  • Universidade Corporativa no portal Educare;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento , com mais de 60% das vagas preenchidas por processos internos.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido para todos os escritórios da companhia.

Horário flexível, com política de jornada dentro de faixas definidas, incluindo opções de home office.

Trabalho remoto estendido para mães recém-licenciadas por até 3 meses, de acordo com a função.

Acreditamos na excelência do ensino e valorizamos os egressos em nossos processos seletivos.

Compromisso com inclusão: todas as vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, valorizando a diversidade.

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós. Por favor, não deixe de responder.

description:
Job description

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.


Main responsibilities

Estamos em busca de um Analista Júnior para integrar o time de Tecnologia e atuar na gestão e evolução do ambiente Microsoft 365 (Office 365), com destaque para o projeto estratégico de adoção do Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Este profissional terá como missão não apenas garantir o suporte e a administração básica da plataforma (usuários, licenças, permissões, segurança), mas também ser protagonista no acompanhamento e engajamento dos usuários no uso do Copilot, ajudando a transformar a forma como nossa empresa utiliza a inteligência artificial para gerar produtividade, eficiência e inovação.

Será um papel que exige curiosidade, capacidade de aprender rápido e vontade de atuar como agente de transformação digital, apoiando usuários de diferentes áreas, monitorando indicadores de uso e trazendo insights sobre ganhos de produtividade.

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Atuar na administração do Microsoft 365: gestão de contas, licenças, permissões e suporte aos usuários;
  • Apoiar usuários em demandas relacionadas a Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive e demais ferramentas do pacote;
  • Ser ponto focal no projeto de adoção do Microsoft 365 Copilot , acompanhando o uso das 300 licenças em vigor;
  • Criar materiais simples (guias rápidos, tutoriais, FAQs) e promover treinamentos práticos para usuários;
  • Coletar percepções dos colaboradores sobre o impacto do Copilot e consolidar relatórios de ganho de produtividade;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de comunicação e engajamento em torno do uso das ferramentas digitais;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de TI na melhoria contínua da experiência dos usuários no Microsoft 365.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas do Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint);
  • Noções de administração de usuários, grupos e licenças no Microsoft 365 Admin Center;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e de conduzir treinamentos práticos para usuários;

description:

Join to apply for the Health Coach role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Function
The purpose of this position is to evaluate and improve the health and wellness of clients. The position is responsible for the supervision of medical and clerical staff in collaboration with the Medical Director to maintain quality services and efficient operations.
Supervisory
Responsible for orienting and training medical and clerical staff and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include medical faculty, Faculty Practice Plan staff, HU/HUH staff, third party payers. External contacts include executive alumni, vendors/contractors, and general public and external agencies.
Principal Accountabilities
  • Guide clients toward optimal health within the continuum of chronic disease to well-being.
  • Facilitate client’s behavior change using mindfulness skills and motivational interviewing.
  • Counsel clients to asses their overall health and determine long-term goals
  • Help clients develop strategies for achieving goals.
  • Collaborate with provider to ensure that strategies align with overall treatment plans
  • Conduct one-on-one health coaching sessions by providing client education and instruction as directed by the provider.
  • Coordinate medical referrals from provider to specialists for clients with chronic comorbidities.
  • Maintain referral log/referral tracking system and distributes to the appropriate provider.
  • Record patients' medical history, vital statistics, and information such as test results in medical records.
  • Retrieves lab reports, dictations, and files and maintains orderly records.
  • Prepare treatment rooms for patient examinations, keeping the rooms neat and clean.
  • Authorize drug refills and provide prescription information to pharmacies.
  • Clean and sterilize instruments and dispose of contaminated supplies.
  • Prepare and administer immunizations and medications as directed by a provider.
  • Manage vaccine inventory for your clinic.
  • Orders all necessary vaccines and medical supplies for the efficient operation of the clinic to ensure compliance with current healthcare regulations, medical laws, and high ethical standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and documentation in accordance with grant guidelines and confidentiality requirements.
  • Assist in data collection and outcome measurement efforts, ensuring the timely and accurate reporting for grant effectiveness.
  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data in core performance measures that are most critical to the care and treatment of patients.
  • Monitor health and immunization status of clients to improve patient outcomes.
  • Supervise all medical and clerical Staff to ensure adherence to policies, procedures, and standard systems.
  • Implement and supervise effective front office business processes. These processes will include acting as a liaison between the clinic and FPP administration to assists with closures of provider
  • schedules and supporting the medical director to oversee the daily work and performance of the medical and clerical staff.
  • Make recommendations for staff to receive appropriate training and support to perform job functions.
  • Keep leadership informed about staff performance.
  • Coordinating and overseeing regular building maintenance and repairs.
  • Represents department appropriately and maintains effective relationships within the clinical enterprise including ancillary departments, HUH, Faculty Practice Plan Business Office, employers, and other key constituencies.
  • Performs other business duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
  • Knowledge of supervisory practices and principles.
  • Skill in organizing work of self and others.
  • Ability to plan, organize, coordinate and prioritize work in situations where demands of a diverse nature are involved.
  • Knowledge of personal computer and accompanying user friendly word- processing, database, spreadsheet, and presentation software
  • Knowledge of the activities of clinic operations in order to perform necessary administrative/clerical functions and requirements of the organization.
  • Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.
  • Knowledge of Medical Terminology
  • Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed. Skill in taking vital signs.
  • Skill in maintaining records and recording test results.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with clients, medical staff, and the public.
  • Ability to be detailed oriented, follow established priorities or procedures, and deliver quality customer service.
  • Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and behave with tact, decorum and diplomacy.
  • Ability to maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, employees, and the public.
  • Ability to communicate with people from various educational levels and backgrounds.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree and 1-3 years of related work experience. 8 years of related work experience in health coaching, wellness, or a related field (e.g., counseling, fitness, or healthcare) may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications. Relevant Experience:
Certification from a recognized health coaching program (e.g., National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching, ACE, ICF) is required. Previous supervisory responsibility required.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro/Comercial Pleno - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Site Name: Brazil - Rio de Janeiro
Posted Date: Aug 26 2025

A área de NRM (Net Revenue Management) conecta estratégia comercial, analytics e governança para otimizar preço, mix, descontos e trade terms, garantindo compliance, qualidade de dados e execução consistente junto a atacados e grandes redes. O foco é proteção de preço e margem, considerando impactos tributários.

Suas responsabilidades

Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ a oportunidade de liderar atividades-chave para progredir na SUA carreira. Algumas delas são:

  • Acompanhar Net Price, descontos, rebates e investimentos por cliente/canal, garantindo governança de pricing e recomposição de preço/mix quando necessário.

  • Assegurar a acurácia de accruals (provisões) e reconciliações de investimentos comerciais e programas de suporte ao paciente.

  • Conduzir o fechamento comercial/financeiro, explicando variações entre estimado e realizado e endereçando root causes.

  • Elaborar cenários e business cases, modelando impactos de preço, mix, packs, rota ao mercado e efeitos tributários (ex.: ICMS-ST).

  • Traduzir análises financeiras em comunicação executiva objetiva, por meio de relatórios e materiais claros para a liderança.

  • Padronizar e otimizar processos, sugerindo automações simples que aumentem velocidade e confiabilidade.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:
Estamos à procura de profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência em Planejamento Financeiro/Comercial, Pricing/NRM ou Finanças de Negócio.

  • Excel avançado (modelagem, PROCs, funções financeiras e dashboards).

  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

Seu diferencial:

Será um plus para sua inscrição se você tiver:

  • Conhecimento de rota ao mercado (direto vs. atacado), PSP e dinâmica de sell-in vs. sell-out no varejo farma.

  • Vivência com ICMS-ST e impactos tributários na formação de preço/margem.

  • Experiência com SAP (módulos comerciais/financeiros).

  • Conhecimento em Python para automatizar análises e rotinas.

Por que GSK?

A GSK continua comprometida em alcançar ambições comerciais ousadas para o futuro. Até 2031, pretendemos entregar £ 40 bilhões em vendas anuais, alavancando nosso forte impulso de desempenho existente para aumentar significativamente nosso impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pacientes em todo o mundo. Nossa estratégia Ahead Together está centrada na intervenção precoce para prevenir e alterar o curso da doença, protegendo assim as pessoas e apoiando os sistemas de saúde. Nosso portfólio diversificado consiste em vacinas, medicamentos especializados e medicamentos gerais. Por meio da inovação contínua e de um foco dedicado à excelência científica e técnica, nos esforçamos para desenvolver e lançar tratamentos novos e inovadores que atendam aos desafios críticos de saúde.

Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

When applying, you may also choose to provide personal information, which helps us ensure a more inclusive selection process. Rest assured, your information will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and will not be accessible to hiring managers. Let’s keep maintaining an inclusive and welcoming workplace.

title: Consultor de Negócios Jr - Global Trade
description:
EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.
Em Impostos Aduaneiros, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros. #TaxEY
Oportunidades de contratação para as regiões de Belo Horizonte, Campinas, Curitiba, RJ,Botafogo e São Paulo JK
Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?
Como um Consultor Jr , você fará parte do time de Global Trade apoiando a equipe na implantação e evolução de sistemas e processos que suportam as operações de Comercio Exterior em nossos clientes na interseção entre tecnologia, processos e negócio, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Levantar, desenhar e revisar processos de negócio relacionados a Comércio Exterior e integração com sistemas (ERPs, WMS, etc).
  • Participar e conduzir projetos de implantação/upgrade de sistemas, definindo requisitos funcionais e validando entregas.
  • Desenvolver relatórios e dashboards em Power BI; modelagem de dados e unificação de fontes heterogêneas.
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados: elaboração de consultas SQL para extração e análise de dados.
  • Criar soluções e automações em Excel (macros, Power Query) para apoiar análises operacionais.
  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio (Comex, Supply Chain, Fiscal) e TI, garantindo requisitos e prazos.
  • Apoiar testes, homologação e treinamento de usuários.
  • Suportar demandas relacionadas a regimes especiais (com coordenação de especialistas em comércio exterior quando necessário).
Por que você?
Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:
  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em implantação / desenvolvimento de sistemas.
  • Excel avançado (fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query / macros desejável).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI / Data Analytics.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados e SQL (capaz de escrever joins e consultas de análise).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:
  • Técnicas de revisão / desenho de processo; metodologias de implantação de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e gestão de projetos.
  • Conhecimento funcional de fluxos de ERPs (SAP, TOTVS, etc).
  • Certificação OSGT (Thomson Reuters) ou experiência com ferramentas de Comércio Exterior.
  • Noções de processos de Importação/Exportação e regimes especiais (Drawback/RECOF).
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol.
O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .
Quem somos
Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.
Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.
Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.
Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

Job description

Nós somos aFadami Software & Innovation , líder em soluções para concessionárias de rodovias. Há mais de 14 anos entregamos soluções através de sistemas de alta qualidade, seguros e de alto desempenho que movem a vida de milhares de pessoas.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar queries altamente complexas em SQL Server, garantindo máxima performance e escalabilidade;

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e infraestrutura para garantir integração eficiente entre aplicações e bancos de dados.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência avançada e comprovada com SQL Server em ambientes de missão crítica;
  • Domínio de T-SQL e técnicas de otimização de código para alta performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados relacional, normalização e práticas de governança de dados;
  • Experiência consistente na criação e otimização de stored procedures, functions, triggers e views complexas;
  • Expertise em tuning de performance, índices, particionamento e análise de gargalos de acesso a dados;
  • Vivência com ETL, processamento massivo e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento profundo de segurança de banco de dados, controle de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de transações e concorrência, aplicando padrões para alta disponibilidade;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de desempenho;
  • Experiência com versionamento de scripts (Git, SVN, etc.).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Azure SQL Database ou outras plataformas de nuvem;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, SSIS, SSRS e integração com soluções analíticas;
  • Experiência com NoSQL, Big Data e Data Warehouse;
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich, the Senior Event Controller will drive in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) Técnico(a) de Projetos que una o melhor dos dois mundos: visão estratégica de gestão com background técnico sólido, especialmente em C# e .NET/.NET Core. Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar iniciativas de produto digital com alto impacto, atuando junto a times multidisciplinares, promovendo excelência técnica e alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa.

Se você começou sua carreira como desenvolvedor(a), cresceu dominando arquitetura, performance e integrações de sistemas, e hoje atua como líder técnico(a) ou coordenador(a), essa vaga é para você.

Buscamos alguém com uma mentalidade proativa, que tenha facilidade em aprender e dominar diferentes ferramentas e soluções, sempre buscando inovação e eficiência. Se você tem um perfil dinâmico, gosta de trabalhar em ambientes que exigem agilidade e adaptação constante, e é motivado por resultados, venha fazer parte de nossa equipe!

  • Liderar técnica e estrategicamente equipes de produto e desenvolvimento, com foco em entregas consistentes, qualidade técnica e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Traduzir a estratégia do negócio em soluções tecnológicas robustas, garantindo a viabilidade técnica e a aderência ao roadmap da área;
  • Participar ativamente das decisões técnicas, atuando como referência para o time em arquitetura, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e stack .NET;
  • Gerenciar projetos de ponta a ponta, acompanhando cronogramas, riscos, dependências e recursos;
  • Promover integração com stakeholders, facilitando a comunicação entre áreas técnicas e não técnicas;
  • Conduzir melhorias de processo, adotando metodologias ágeis e práticas de governança alinhadas à cultura da empresa;
  • Atuar como facilitador(a) de conflitos, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, produtivo e inovador.
  • Sólida experiência com C# e .NET/.NET Core (preferencialmente no início da carreira), com histórico prático em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Atuação atual ou recente em coordenação/liderança de equipes ou projetos na área de tecnologia ou produto digital;
  • Vivência em portais on-line transacionais voltados ao usuário final, com fluxo de cadastro, autenticação e pagamentos digitais;
  • Experiência em sistemas de alta disponibilidade e arquitetura escalável, garantindo performance e estabilidade sob alto volume de acessos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em integrações com sistemas externos, APIs REST e gateways de pagamento;
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server (nível básico a intermediário);
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, planejamento, gestão de entregas e condução de reuniões técnicas e estratégicas.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com portais de pagamento, adquirência ou ecossistemas de pagamento digital;
  • Atuação no setor de concessões de pedágio, mobilidade urbana ou serviços públicos digitais;
  • Certificações ou prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de DevOps, observabilidade e pipelines de CI/CD.

O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente desafiador e inovador, com grande espaço para autonomia e protagonismo;
  • Projetos de alta visibilidade com impacto direto no negócio e no usuário final;
  • Cultura de valorização técnica, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento profissional.
  • Plano de saúde SulAmérica;
  • Plano odontológico SulAmérica;
  • Day Off no dia do aniversário + Vale presente;
  • Auxílio cultura;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído, agradável e acolhedor.

Outros:

  • Open English (inglês e espanhol);
  • Descontos com o Grupo de Hotéis Fazenda Montanhês

Faça parte da maior fábrica de softwares para rodovias do Brasil!

A Fadami é uma fábrica de software especializada em soluções para concessionárias de rodovias. Com 14 anos de mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas robustos, seguros e de alto desempenho, combinando inovação e tecnologia para otimizar a gestão e os processos operacionais do setor.

Nosso time é formado por especialistas em desenvolvimento e suporte, trabalhando lado a lado para entregar soluções eficientes e uma experiência excepcional ao cliente. Enquanto a equipe de desenvolvimento cria e aprimora nossos sistemas, o time de suporte garante uma implementação fluida e um atendimento próximo, solucionando desafios e assegurando o melhor desempenho das nossas soluções.

Aqui, não vendemos apenas sistemas — oferecemos toda a estrutura necessária para uma implementação completa e eficaz.

Venha fazer parte da Fadami e ajude a construir o futuro da tecnologia!

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: I actually read the instructions

You're a visual storyteller. You understand how to weave together raw footage, graphics, and sound to create compelling video content, with a particular focus on transforming property tours, market updates, and agent expertise into engaging real estate content that drives leads and builds authority. You obsess over the smallest details - the right cut, the perfect transition, the ideal color grade - without losing sight of the overall narrative. You're capable of taking a creative brief and bringing it to life through video, consistently delivering high-quality content within rapid turnaround times.

You have a discerning eye and ear for video and sound design. You appreciate the subtleties of color grading and understand how to use sound design to enhance the visual experience. Your creative expertise isn't limited to "Layer 1" or "Audio Track 2" - you deliver clean, organized project files that are easy for others to work with.

You are a YouTube specialist. You're familiar with the unique requirements of editing for YouTube, from creating engaging openings that hook viewers, to incorporating calls to action, to optimizing for viewer retention. You're always up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices on the platform, particularly in real estate content.

You report to and learn from an experienced YouTube Manager while maintaining direct communication with multiple real estate clients. A Stone
Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.
Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.
Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.
Nossa Cultura
A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.
Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.
A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.
Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
Como é Ser Um(a) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Inbound)
Você será responsável por realizar vendas consultivas de forma receptiva, conectando as necessidades do(a) cliente às nossas soluções financeiras, com foco em um atendimento de excelência.
Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá gerir as vendas por meio dos nossos canais de atendimento (chat, WhatsApp e telefone), garantindo agilidade e assertividade.
O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência prévia com vendas (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas.
O Que Aumenta Suas Chances
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Interesse em se especializar na área de vendas.

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Com horário de entrada entre 08h e 13h | Escala: 5x2 (Possibilidade de trabalho aos sábados ou domingos)

Novos Benefícios - Em breve, teremos benefícios exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
Apresentação Pessoal: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário e encaminhar um vídeo com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies e motivações e sonhos.
Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone
Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer for Ceph & Distributed Storage. As part of Cloud Engineering, you'll be building modelling software to drive systems such as OpenStack, Ceph, and Kubernetes with a focus on distributed storage and Ceph. You'll be engineering solutions to scale in production, working with our field teams to ensure we're meeting the needs of customers looking to adopt cutting-edge technology.
Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.
This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.
Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality, rigorously designed Python and Golang software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation that define best practices for authoring high quality operators
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Develop and maintain software for delivery, operations and life-cycle management of Ceph storage
What we are looking for in you
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with writing modern, maintainable Python
  • You have experience with Ceph storage
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience operating Ceph clusters in production
  • Experience with open source distributed storage such as Gluster, Minio, Mayastor or similar
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About the project:

As a Senior Workfront Configuration Engineer , you will be responsible for gathering and understanding clients’ unique business requirements and translating them into customized solutions using Workfront and Workfront Fusion. This includes designing, configuring, and maintaining optimized workflow solutions that help clients achieve their operational goals. You will be part of a highly collaborative, international team using agile methodologies and committed to delivering impactful, high-quality solutions through the implementation of best practices.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design, implement, configure, and maintain client Workfront instances.

Support with Workfront Fusion integration needs.

Understand the architecture requirements to ensure the foundation is solid and appropriate sharing rules are in place.

Provide and be knowledgeable in 'best practices' in Workfront development to optimize efficiency and quality of deliverables.

Maintain and enhance existing Workfront instances, including updates, user management, and new feature rollouts.

Develop custom reports, dashboards, forms, and workflows to meet user needs.

Participate in requirement discussions to gain added insights from the customer needs.

Document and communicate the architecture strategy, and work with the execution team and project manager to establish timelines and schedules for implementation and measurement.

Collaborate with the delivery team and client regarding product definition, schedule, scope, and project-related decisions.

Design, develop, deliver, and maintain features and applications of Workfront that will excite our client stakeholders.

Develop solutions that are Secure, Measurable, Usable, Reliable, Flexible, and Scalable.

Work collaboratively in an Agile/Scrum team to plan sprints, expand stories into tasks, work on removing impediments, and execute at top velocity.

Stay current on Workfront platform updates and industry trends to propose innovative solutions.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

5+ Years of experience working in the design, implementation, and support of project management systems.

1+ Years of experience working in Workfront Fusion.

Experience in AEM development is a plus.

Integrating Workfront with other Adobe Platforms from Adobe's ecosystem is a plus (AEM, AEP, Marketo, Adobe Firefly).

Certifications are desired – Developer Certification is desirable, Business or Practitioner is acceptable.

Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our hiring process

1. Let’s chat about your experience!

2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.

3. Nail that, and you’ll meet our client - your final step to joining our amazing team!

At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!

We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.

Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!

Job description for Offshore Planner position

Reports To: Offshore Maintenance Superintendent (hierarchically)
Onshore Planning Lead (functionally)


Background: This position will be responsible for the look ahead and ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements. They are the owner of 14 and 28 days look ahead.
Accountable For: Typical Responsibilities & Standards

1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
2) Implementation of Management System
Ensure compliance with applicable IOP planning and CMMS procedure.
Liaise, prepare and update Unit weekly planning and scheduling activities.
Conduct weekly Planning meetings with offshore HOD’s and onshore IOP planner to freeze 14 days look ahead schedule.
Ensure any conflict in respect to SIMOPS, resources and materials are highlighted to the relevant parties.
Ensure in conjunction with all HOD’s that all assurance activities are carried out on the schedule and comply with unit’s verification scheme.
Responsible for reviewing & prioritizing all corrective work requests with the work team to ensure corrective work order priorities are properly assigned.
3) Control of Works
Offshore owner of 14 and 28 days plan lookahead, ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements.
Monitor weekly execution progress
When required develop work plans for maintenance jobs with necessary information to allow efficient scheduling, assignment, and execution of maintenance work.
Perform site readiness check and validate the appropriate job work scope with the offshore disciplines and feedback to onshore unit planner.
Monitor Maintenance KPIs and performances, warn support team of any recurring problems related to the maintenance activity back log.
Suggests improvements and requests modifications for planning and for the CMMS and Work Order flow chart.
4) Management of Conditions, Behaviours and Events
Contribute to the continued improvement and implementation of the best practices in the planning discipline.
Review CMMS reporting are done efficiently and correctly. Equally, help with CMMS activities such as correction of Notifications, upload activities report under CMMS, and so on.

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience
Degree in relevant technical or business discipline or can be substituted by suitable industry experience.
Extensive experience as a maintenance planner or Supervisor in oil and gas upstream industries.
A basic knowledge of the process of oil and gas treatment, installations and a thorough knowledge of the equipment used in oil and gas treatment installations.
Experience in Planning software (primavera P6) and CMMS (IFS) and electronic Permit-to-Work systems.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.

GENERAL INFORMATION

Customer Experience Supervisor (English speaking)

Join to apply for the Customer Experience Supervisor (English speaking) role at MANUAL

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Global Patient Experience Team. Based in Rio and working directly with our Global Patient Experience Team (located in Brazil, England and the Philippines).
Your goal is to build and lead a world-class patient experience team, ensuring our patients get seamless, high-quality support throughout their journey. You’ll be responsible for managing a team of agents, developing processes, and driving performance—making sure we’re delivering the best possible care while also operating efficiently.
This is a rare opportunity to take ownership of a growing team and shape how we support patients at MANUAL. You’ll play a key role in optimising our operations, scaling the team effectively, and ensuring we’re always improving the experience we offer.
You’re someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving problems, and knows how to inspire and develop a team to deliver outstanding service.
This role is based in Rio, but you'll work directly with our UK Team. So fluency in English is a requirement.
What You’ll Do

  • Managing a team of Patient Experience Specialists, setting clear expectations and driving performance
  • Coaching and developing your team, ensuring every agent has the support and guidance to succeed
  • Building a strong team culture that motivates and empowers agents to provide the best experience
  • Identifying trends in patient contacts, feedback, and complaints—then leading initiatives to improve our processes
  • Working closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Operations, Medical) to remove roadblocks and make it easier for patients to get the help they need
  • Using data to track performance, set ambitious targets, and drive continuous improvement
How You Operate
  • Think big - you're inspired by frighteningly ambitious solutions to big patient problems and your team’s problems , you approach them from first principles and you have the determination to clear hurdles to get there.
  • Move fast - you set just the right pace, you collaborate well and you're a clear communicator that can quickly understand patient problems and develop long lasting, efficient solutions.
  • Make it better - you think about the bigger picture, you have a growth mindset with yourself and others (including a healthy relationship with feedback), you're hard on problems not people and do whatever you can to help our patients and your team
Job requirements
  • Fluent in English
  • You have experience managing a customer support team in a fast-paced environment, ideally within healthtech, or a similar industry
  • You’re passionate about coaching and developing people—you love seeing your team succeed
  • You’re highly organised and comfortable balancing multiple priorities
  • You’re comfortable using data to track performance and make informed decisions
  • You have a “roll up your sleeves” attitude—if something needs fixing, you’re happy to get stuck in
  • You’re excited about what we’re building at MANUAL and want to help shape the future of patient experience
Benefits
  • Share option scheme
  • Private medical insurance
  • Gym & wellness benefit with Wellhub
  • Hybrid role based in Rio de Janeiro 2-3 days a week
  • 30 days holidays
  • Annual company retreat
  • A fun and friendly working environment with sharp and motivated co-workers
  • Join in the early stages of one of the most promising start-ups in the health & wellness space

No Gurumê , acreditamos que a segurança é parte essencial da nossa excelência em hospitalidade e operação. Buscamos um(a) Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho para atuar de forma estratégica e prática, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade legal para colaboradores, clientes e parceiros. Esse profissional terá papel fundamental na implantação de programas de prevenção, na promoção da cultura de segurança e na construção de processos cada vez mais sustentáveis dentro do restaurante!
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar vistorias periódicas nas unidades e áreas de suporte, emitindo relatórios e propondo adequações;
  • Implantar e acompanhar os programas de segurança (PGR, PCMSO, LTP, LTI, PAE), garantindo atualização e conformidade legal;
  • Coordenar o desenvolvimento da CIPA e da Brigada de Incêndio, incluindo treinamentos, reuniões, rondas e planos de trabalho;
  • Atuar na prevenção de incêndios, incluindo verificação de equipamentos, sinalizações, rotas de fuga e planos de evacuação;
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes/incidentes, elaborando relatórios e propondo medidas corretivas e preventivas;
  • Garantir a entrega, registro e fiscalização do uso adequado de EPIs, bem como a atualização das fichas de controle;
  • Implementar programas de ergonomia, sinalização de segurança e controle de riscos críticos;
  • Manter e controlar FISPQs de produtos químicos utilizados nas operações;
  • Acompanhar e validar atestados médicos, ASOs e demais documentos de saúde ocupacional;
  • Apoiar gestores e líderes na integração de novos colaboradores, garantindo treinamentos normativos obrigatórios;
  • Desenvolver campanhas e treinamentos regulares, promovendo a cultura de segurança no Gurumê;
  • Realizar auditorias internas de segurança, checklists e acompanhamento semanal dos planos de ação;
  • Apoiar no relacionamento com órgãos fiscalizadores e manter a empresa em conformidade com todas as normas trabalhistas e de segurança do trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho com registro ativo no MTE (conforme Lei nº 7.410/85 e NR-4);
  • Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras aplicáveis: NR-5 (CIPA), NR-6 (EPIs), NR-10 (Segurança em Instalações Elétricas), NR-12 (Máquinas e Equipamentos), NR-23 (Prevenção de Incêndio), NR-26 (Sinalização), NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura), NR-36 (Segurança em Atividades de Abate/Alimentos);
  • Habilidade em ministrar treinamentos e DDS (Diálogos Diários/Semanais de Segurança);
  • Capacidade de elaborar relatórios, checklists, indicadores e planos de ação (PDCA);
  • Conhecimento em PGR (Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), PCMSO, e Planos de Emergência;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ergonomia aplicada, controle de produtos químicos (FISPQ), e gestão de terceiros;
  • Boa comunicação, senso de urgência e perfil de atuação prática ("mão na massa").

Diferencial
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas de segurança em restaurantes, indústrias alimentícias ou ambientes de grande fluxo operacional.

Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products. In addition, you will help write Juju charms to manage operational concerns.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Write Juju charms (operators) to manage operational concerns
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence

title: Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction
description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.

description:

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.
This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.
You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.
You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.
 What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.
  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.
  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.
  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.
  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.
  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.
  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)
  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.
  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.
  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.
  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.
Soft Skills:
  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.
  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.
  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.
Nice to Have
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts
What it's like to work at Darkroom:
  • We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in LA, The Bay Area, New York, Philly, Sao Paulo, Lisbon, and Eastern Europe.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
